observations.statement: Checkout returns 504 payment_timeout after about 9 ms, while the gateway's documented latency is 40-120 ms
v1.2.1 redeployed the same commit as v1.2.0, so the code did not change

hypotheses.summary: The v1.2.1 deploy set PAYMENT_TIMEOUT_MS far below the gateway's 40-120 ms latency, so every capture times out; the code is unchanged, so this is a configuration problem.
hypotheses.confidence_rationale: Same commit in both deploys and sub-10 ms timeouts; the deployed environment value itself is not in the evidence.
missing_information: The PAYMENT_TIMEOUT_MS value in the v1.2.1 environment

data_gaps: Deployed environment variables are not collected
